# Error Exposure from Third-Party Providers

If the OpenAI or Azure OpenAI SDKs raise unexpected errors (such as network issues or API changes), these are wrapped but may still surface as provider errors in the calling context, potentially interrupting embedding workflows.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/llm/embeddings.py` — `knowledge_compiler.llm.embeddings.OpenAIEmbedder`
- `knowledge_compiler/llm/embeddings.py` — `knowledge_compiler.llm.embeddings.OpenAIEmbedder.embed`
- `knowledge_compiler/llm/embeddings.py` — `knowledge_compiler.llm.embeddings.AzureOpenAIEmbedder`
